parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Only tables in this category, e.g. Outdoor. "Uncategorised" for tables with none.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD, Uganda time. Today when left out.

info.title: HORECA API
info.description: HORECA API. Responses use the envelope {statusCode, message, payload, timestamp}; the examples show the full envelope. Sample requests and responses are added to the newer routes (sign-in, staff, PIN policy, activity, payouts, approvals, reservations, stock, settings, push alerts).

username.description: 3 to 30 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore. Must not be used by anyone else.

tabName.description: Required for a tab, e.g. the customer name

ageVerifiedBy.description: Name of the staff member who checked the customer ID. Required for age-restricted items.

phoneNumber.description: Customer Mobile Money number. Required for mobile_money.

section.description: Floor area the table belongs to
Floor area. Send an empty text to remove it.

status.description: Free, reserved for a guest, or needing cleaning. A table with an open order shows as occupied by itself.

isActive.description: false hides the item from the menu without deleting it

openingFloat.description: Cash already in the drawer, whole UGX

countedCash.description: Cash counted in the drawer, whole UGX

kind.description: mobile_money sends to a phone; bill pays water, electricity or TV; airtime buys airtime for a number

phone.description: mobile_money and airtime: the number to pay. bill: a phone number for the receipt message.

customerRef.description: Required for a bill: the meter, account or smartcard number

option.description: Water area or electricity type, when the biller needs one

paidOn.description: Uganda date it was paid. Today when left out.

payoutApprovalLimit.description: Payments out at or above this need the owner. Whole UGX.

approverPin.description: A manager or the owner types their PIN. Not needed when the caller is a manager.

itemId.description: One line only. When left out the discount applies to every unbilled line (percent only).

itemIds.description: Lines to move onto a new bill for the same table

reorderLevel.description: Warn when stock falls to this level

costPrice.description: Usual cost per unit, whole UGX

kind.description: purchase adds, waste takes away, count sets what is really on the shelf

unitCost.description: Cost per unit for a purchase, whole UGX

paidMethod.description: For a purchase: also record the payment out now, using this method

username.description: Left out: made from the name (sarah.kato). Must not be used by anyone else.

email.description: The person's OWN email. Their PIN is sent here. Email or phone is required.

phone.description: The person's OWN phone. Their PIN is sent here by SMS.

sendPasswordLink.description: Also email them a link to set their own password, so they can sign in without a PIN device. Default: true for managers, false for other roles. Needs an email.

loginId.description: Email address, or the staff username given by the business

deviceSecret.description: A long random secret the device keeps. Only its hash is stored.

username.description: The person's username. The PIN alone never identifies anyone.

pin.description: The PIN, checked against this username only.
